definition: Neurodevelopmental disorder with progressive microcephaly, spasticity, and brain anomalies (NDMSBA), a rare autosomal recessive genetic condition caused by mutations in the PLAA gene.

source.title: Genetic alterations in atypical cerebral palsy identified through chromosomal microarray and exome sequencing
